item.title: Parasakthi Worldwide Box Office Collections: Sivakarthikeyan starrer puts up good Rs 47 crore in 3 days
item.description: Sivakarthikeyan's latest release, Parasakthi, is performing well at the box office. item.title: Zootopia 2 Worldwide Box Office: Disney's animated film maintains strong run, grossing USD 1.66 billion in 45 days
item.description: Zootopia 2 continues to maintain a strong hold at the box office. The animated buddy cop action drama grossed USD 31.8 million in the international markets in its 7th weekend, bringing the overseas cume to USD 1.28 billion in 45 days of theatrical run. Allied to its USD 378.7 million cume in home markets, the Zootopia sequel stormed a solid USD 1.66 billion at the worldwide box office. item.title: Dhurandhar Box Office: Ranveer Singh's latest blockbuster film registers a spike on 6th Tuesday, nears Rs 765 crore mark
item.description: Dhurandhar maintained a strong hold in its 6th week too. The movie collected Rs. 2.50 crore on Tuesday, registering a spike of 20 percent. This took the 6th week cume to Rs. 19.25 crore, which is again an all-time record for an Indian film. Dhurandhar stormed past the previous recordholder, Stree 2 (Rs. 17 crore), and recorded the biggest 6th week of all time at the Hindi box office, that too, in 5 days only.
